skill.name: performance-analyzer
skill.description: Analyze influencer campaign performance from supplied platform, web analytics, sales, and promo-code data. Compare results against targets and benchmarks, rank creators and platforms, assess engagement quality, and produce optimization recommendations.
skill.summary: Analyzes influencer campaign results, creator performance, attribution, and next-step recommendations.
skill.author: aaron-he-zhu

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from Markdown links, fenced examples, inline path labels, and homepage metadata. The confirmed risks are limited to a YouTube connector command that runs local Python and may read YOUTUBE_API_KEY; no prompt injection or exfiltration intent was found.

remediation.issue: External connector execution from skill instructions
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation before running the YouTube connector, show the exact command, and restrict execution to the trusted connector path.

remediation.issue: Environment credential access for YouTube data
remediation.suggestion: Document how YOUTUBE_API_KEY is used, avoid printing it in outputs, and offer a manual data path for users who do not want connector access.

remediation.issue: Deep relative Markdown links create scanner noise
remediation.suggestion: Consider repository-root link aliases or shorter relative links where supported to reduce false path traversal alerts.

content.value_statement: Influencer campaign results are hard to compare across creators, platforms, and attribution sources. This skill turns supplied metrics into scorecards, rankings, quality reads, and recommendations.
actual_capabilities: Builds campaign scorecards against targets and benchmarks from supplied metrics.
Ranks platforms, creators, and content formats by performance indicators.
Analyzes engagement quality, comment sentiment, and purchase intent signals.
Breaks down conversions by promo code, UTM, direct, and estimated attribution.
Produces ranked learnings, roster recommendations, and future campaign guidance.
limitations: Requires user-supplied exports, screenshots, analytics, or sales data for most analysis.
Does not perform detailed dollar-level ROI modeling; it hands off to an ROI skill.
Cannot verify private platform metrics unless the user provides data or enables a connector.
Statistical winner claims depend on sample size and benchmark quality.

use_cases.title: Post-Campaign Review
use_cases.description: Summarize whether an influencer campaign met reach, engagement, conversion, and revenue targets.

use_cases.title: Creator Renewal Decisions
use_cases.description: Compare creators by performance, engagement quality, conversion contribution, and recommended next action.

use_cases.title: Platform and Content Learning
use_cases.description: Identify which platforms, formats, hooks, and messages should guide the next campaign plan.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Campaign Analysis
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request with a campaign name and pasted metrics.
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze the performance of this influencer campaign using the metrics below. Score results against targets, name top performers, and list the main learnings: [paste campaign data].

prompt_templates.title: Creator Comparison
prompt_templates.scenario: Compare several creators within one campaign.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare these creators from the campaign. Rank them by reach, engagement rate, conversions, engagement quality, and renewal recommendation: [paste creator metrics].

prompt_templates.title: Attribution Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Connect creator activity to web, promo-code, and sales outcomes.
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze conversion attribution for this influencer campaign. Separate promo-code, UTM, direct, and estimated influence results, then explain confidence and gaps: [paste attribution data].

prompt_templates.title: Advanced Benchmark Readout
prompt_templates.scenario: Full performance review with targets, benchmarks, and recommendations.
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a full campaign performance readout with metric scorecards, platform rankings, creator rankings, content patterns, sentiment themes, attribution notes, and next-campaign recommendations: [paste full dataset].

output_examples.input: A campaign exported reach, engagement, clicks, conversions, promo-code use, and creator cost data.
output_examples.output: A scorecard shows reach above target, conversions below target, TikTok as the strongest platform, and two creators recommended for renewal.

output_examples.input: A brand needs to decide which creators to renew after a launch campaign.
output_examples.output: A ranked creator table explains who to renew, who to test again, and who to replace based on conversion and engagement quality.

output_examples.input: A team has comments, saves, shares, and purchase questions from several sponsored posts.
output_examples.output: An engagement quality read identifies purchase-intent themes, weaker comment quality, and content hooks to reuse next time.

best_practices: Provide campaign dates, platform exports, creator reports, and conversion data in one request.
Separate measured data from creator-supplied data when sources disagree.
Use clear targets and benchmarks before asking for winner or renewal recommendations.
anti_patterns: Do not call a creator a winner from small samples without significance checks.
Do not mix estimated attribution with measured conversions without labels.
Do not use this skill as a substitute for detailed ROI or payback modeling.

faq.question: What data should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide campaign dates, creator handles, platform metrics, web analytics, promo-code data, sales data, targets, and benchmarks when available.

faq.question: Can it compare creators?
faq.answer: Yes. It ranks creators by reach, engagement rate, conversions, content quality, and renewal recommendation.

faq.question: Can it analyze engagement quality?
faq.answer: Yes. It separates passive engagement from comments, saves, shares, clicks, and purchase-intent signals.

faq.question: Does it calculate ROI?
faq.answer: It can report ROI inputs and simple comparisons, but detailed dollar-level ROI is handled by the ROI calculator skill.

faq.question: Does it require live integrations?
faq.answer: No. It works from pasted or uploaded data. A YouTube connector can be used when configured and approved.

faq.question: How does it handle uncertain attribution?
faq.answer: It labels attribution methods separately and explains confidence for promo-code, UTM, direct, and estimated influence results.
